googleWorkspaceFields.accountHelp: The Google account this source reads.
googleWorkspaceFields.mailContent: How much of each message to read
googleWorkspaceFields.mailContentHelp: Google is asked for no more than this.
googleWorkspaceFields.mailContentHeaders: Headers and labels only, no message text
googleWorkspaceFields.connectFailed: The sign-in could not be completed.
googleWorkspaceFields.mailSearchHelp: A search exactly as you would type it in Gmail's search box. Leave empty for all mail.
googleWorkspaceFields.mailSearchCost: A source that searches is read again whole on every refresh.
googleWorkspaceFields.mailLabelsHelp: One label name per line. Only mail carrying every one is read. Leave empty for all mail.
googleWorkspaceFields.notSetUp: Your organization has not connected Google Workspace yet.
googleWorkspaceFields.notSetUpAsk: Your organization has not connected Google Workspace yet. Ask an administrator to set it up under {{where}}.
googleWorkspaceFields.whoseHelp: One mailbox is connected by its owner. The organization's mailboxes are read with the organization's own access, once an administrator has allowed it.
googleWorkspaceFields.everyMailbox: One table holds every mailbox's rows. A role that may read the table reads every mailbox, unless a row rule on the account column says otherwise.
googleWorkspaceFields.notAllowed: Your organization has not allowed sources that read its mailboxes.
googleWorkspaceFields.notAllowedAsk: Your organization has not allowed sources that read its mailboxes. Ask an administrator to allow it under {{where}}.
googleWorkspaceFields.groupHelp: The group's address, or its ID. Members of groups inside it are included.
